version: 0.5.0

### Added

- Add @lupinum/ginko/basics: site, legal, people, posts, authors, changelog, jobs, faq and downloads bricks. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add country and sessions to @lupinum/ginko/basics; move hours, notices, events and gallery into basics (preset-gastro re-exports them unchanged). ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `breadcrumbJsonLd(steps, siteUrl)` to `@lupinum/ginko`: a JSON-LD BreadcrumbList from steps with `title` and `path`, such as the nodes of `useGinkoBreadcrumbs` (templates/_features/site/app/composables/usePageSeo.ts uses it). ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `status` to bricks: a declared status line for the Studio's Today page. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `askAgainWhen` to `choices` fields: the Studio asks whether the choice is still right when the text it answers for changes. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Add `fields` to create tasks: the task asks and writes only those fields. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add an optional `language` field to the `downloads` brick of `@lupinum/ginko/basics`, so a list can say that a document is in another language (template files: `templates/_features/downloads/app/components/downloads/List.vue`). ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `bookingUntil` (the last day the booking link shows) to `events()` and an optional `summary` to `sessions()` from `@lupinum/ginko/basics` (template files: `templates/_features/events/app/composables/useEvents.ts`, `templates/_features/events/app/pages/events/[slug].vue`, `templates/_features/sessions/app/composables/useSessions.ts`, `templates/_features/sessions/app/components/session/Row.vue`, `templates/_features/sessions/app/pages/programme.vue`). ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `hours({ plans: 'hourPlans' })`: the hours name their hour plans in the stored schema (`status: { hours: { plans } }`), the release check refuses a key that is not a collection of hour plans, and the Studio's line for today reads only those plans. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add today's opening hours to the Studio's Today page: `hours()` declares `status: { hours: true }`. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add the site's `country` to page JSON-LD: `useGinkoSeo` fills `addressCountry` (and remote job applicants) where `siteJsonLd` or `jobJsonLd` got none. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `formatMoney(money, language, { wholeWithoutMinor: true })` for "€390" instead of "€390.00", and `offerJsonLd` in `@lupinum/ginko/basics` for a schema.org Offer with an optional VAT note (templates/_features/services/app/composables/useServices.ts). ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `unitCode` to `offerJsonLd(money, currency, { unitCode })` for a recurring price: `MON` per month, `ANN` per year give the Offer a UnitPriceSpecification for one such unit, with `valueAddedTaxIncluded` when given. The pricing feature of the templates (templates/_features/pricing/app/composables/usePricing.ts) uses it for the plans' Offers. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Add `planned` to `single()` and `collection()`: a field whose value changes on a date (`{ field: 'price', next: 'nextPrice', from: 'priceFrom' }`). The platform stores the planned value only with its date, opens a task on the new value from that date on, leaves the plan out of create tasks (Studio and agent tools), and `ginko check` reports a task that changes the field without showing its plan. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add the `authors` option to `posts()`: name the brick the post's authors come from, for example `people`. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `releaseAnchor(version)` to `@lupinum/ginko/basics`: the anchor of a release on a changelog page (`4.6.0` → `v4-6-0`). The changelog page of `@lupinum/ginko-docs` and the changelog feature of the templates (templates/_features/changelog/app/composables/useChangelog.ts, server/middleware/changelog-feed.ts) use it, so both keep the same public addresses. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Add `getGinkoItems(event, brick, locale)` for a site's own server routes (a feed, a calendar): the visible entries of a collection with their address, for file and platform bricks; `rssXml` in `@lupinum/ginko/basics` writes an RSS 2.0 feed (template files: `templates/_features/blog/server/middleware/news-feed.ts`). ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `after` to time fields (an end time must be later than its start) and `timeZone` to the gastro `eventJsonLd`, which then writes the start with the site's offset. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `wordsOf(value)`: the number of words of a Markdown value, also in lists where page state holds only `{ ref }`, for example for a reading time. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add a `ginko check` warning when a brick's field maxima can add up past the entry limit, so a schema does not allow entries the platform refuses at Save. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `pathOf` and `defaultDir` to `@lupinum/ginko/internal`: the file layout of `ginko export`, which the Studio's backup download uses too. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add a warning to `local:files-export` that counts the entries it leaves out (drafts, entries scheduled for later and entries that belong to a draft) and names the first three, so they can be added in the Studio. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Add French, Italian and Arabic messages. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `grantGroups` to `@lupinum/ginko/internal`: a person's rights grouped by area, in the order of the site's schema. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `$file.<id>` references in platform Markdown texts: a picture, component image or link from the Files library is served with its current address, pixel size, smaller copies and library description, and a file that is gone is marked broken instead of loading nothing. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add a `route` option to `people()` from `@lupinum/ginko/basics`: with it, each person gets a web address (a slug made from the name) and a page, for example speakers. Without it the stored fields stay as they are. Template files that read a person's `url` and need the route: `templates/_features/sessions/app/pages/speakers/[slug].vue`, `templates/_features/sessions/app/pages/speakers/index.vue`, `templates/_features/sessions/app/components/session/Speakers.vue` and `templates/_features/sessions/app/composables/useSessions.ts`. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `slugBases` to `@lupinum/ginko/internal`: the slug of a new entry per language before it is made unique, one rule for the platform and the Studio's preview of an entry not saved yet. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add the `dateLanguage` option to `createFormatters` and `createTranslator`: dates in another tag (`en-GB`) while numbers and words stay in `language`. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add scheduled entries for file content: in a collection with drafts that lists its entries newest first by a date (such as `posts()` with `drafts: true`), an entry dated after the build day is left out of the build like a draft, and the first build on or after its date publishes it. The `blog` template feature relies on it (`templates/_features/blog`). ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Add public ways to customize the docs: `<DocsShell>` for a site's own pages in the docs frame, the override points `DocsPageEnd` and `DocsSidebarEnd`, and `docs: { search: false }`. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Add a docs frame for sites that embed the docs in their own layout: no framed panel, the search above the navigation, a phone bar with the navigation as a sheet, and `--docs-gutter` to line the docs up with the site's container. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Add `homePages({ locales })` to `@lupinum/ginko-docs/config`: the start page by locale, with the main locale at `/`. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Add route links outside Markdown: the start page's buttons and cards, `nav`, `footer.links` and `banner.href` take `$docs.<page>` and `$page.<key>`, which lead to the page in the reader's language. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Add `source: 'platform'` to docsCollection, docsHome, blogCollections and changelogCollection, so docs content can be edited in Ginko Studio; the default stays `'files'`. ([#24](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/24))
- Add French texts to the docs layer. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Add CollectionPage JSON-LD and a description to the changelog page, and CollectionPage JSON-LD to the blog list. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Add a note to the language menu for a language that has no version of the page: "Not translated: opens the start page". ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Add availability to the menu and events: a dish can be taken off the menu ("Auf der Karte") or marked sold out for one day (quick task "Gericht heute aus"), an event can be marked fully booked (quick task "Veranstaltung ausgebucht"). `dishOn(dish, date)` gives the rule for the site, and `eventJsonLd` takes `soldOut`. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `menuCategories` and the `MenuCategory` type: the categories of `menu()` in menu order, so a site groups its dishes by the brick's own list (templates/_features/menu/app/composables/useMenu.ts). ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `noticesOn(notices, ctx, today)`: on a day the owner closed, it leaves out a notice that ends today, so "Fully booked today" no longer shows under "Closed today". ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `ends` to what `upcomingPlans` returns: the last day of a coming plan when it has one (a yearly season over New Year ends in the next year), so a site can show "1. November – 31. März: Winterzeiten" instead of the start only. The README now shows `hourPlans` and `lunchPlans` right after the bricks they plan. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add a hint to the reason of a closure or exception: keep it short, because the website shows it as written. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add `isLunchPlaceholder`, which tells a lunch day that still holds the placeholder dish of a fresh site, so a site can leave out its allergen line. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Add a hint to a notice's "Gilt bis": leave it empty to keep the notice until you remove it. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Add the blog template (`--template blog`): posts with tags, authors, reading time, older and newer links, and an RSS feed per language. The company and nonprofit news pages gain the same tag pages, reading time and older/newer links. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Add `--template <name>` and `--locales <codes>`: a complete starter site from Ginko's templates, with the languages you pick (the first is the main one) and its sample dates moved to the current week; `--preset` and `--locale` still work and print that they are deprecated. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))

### Changed

- Change the changelog basic to support drafts and scheduled entries: an entry dated after the build day stays out until the first build on or after its date, and `draft: true` holds an entry back. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Change Markdown refs in page state to carry no table of contents: read `toc` from the loaded text, `(await useGinkoMarkdown(() => entry.value.data.body)).value?.toc`. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Change an outdated translation to stay on the site until someone updates or confirms it, instead of being replaced by the main-language text; `fallback` now lists only missing translations. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Change platform Markdown fields to `{ ref }` in page state, as file bricks already are, so a page's payload carries only the texts it shows. Site code that reads a text's tree from an entry (`entry.data.body.nodes`) gets nothing now: load it with `useGinkoMarkdown(() => entry.value.data.body)` or, for several texts in one `useAsyncData`, `fetchGinkoMarkdown(value)`. `<GinkoMarkdown>` needs no change. A client navigation loads a text it has not shown yet from `/__ginko/platform/<locale>/<rev>/md/…`. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Change a required field with `showWhen` to be required only while it shows: `price: f.money('Amount', { showWhen: { field: 'pricing', is: 'price' } })` now refuses a fixed price without an amount in the build, the Studio and agent tools, and accepts an entry on request without one (templates/_features/services/app/bricks/services.ts). ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Change the default of `untranslated` for collections with a `route`: an entry is left out of a language until its required fields are translated there (no page, a 404 under its address, not in lists, the sitemap, hreflang or llms.txt); set `untranslated: 'fallback'` to list it there with a link to its main-language page. An outdated translation no longer hides anything, also with `'hide'`; only a missing one does. Collections without a `route` (authors, FAQ, dishes) keep `'fallback'` as their default. A missing slug or image description never counts as a missing translation. A link to an entry (`$blog.<name>`) in a translated text goes to its main-language page while the entry has no page in that language. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Change `events()` from `@lupinum/ginko/basics` so `route` is optional: without it the events have no pages, and a site can still list them. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Change `upcomingClosures` and `upcomingHolidayClosures` to leave out a public holiday that falls on a day the week already closes. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Change the robots tag of `useGinkoSeo({ noindex: true })` to `noindex, follow`, so a page kept out of search results (the menu's print page in templates/_features/menu/app/pages/menu/print.vue, a draft) no longer tells search engines to ignore its links. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Change the type of `unitCode` in `offerJsonLd` so editors suggest `MON` and `ANN`; other codes stay valid. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Change the schema check to refuse a brick named `page` or `file`: `$page.…` and `$file.…` in Markdown texts always mean a page and a library file. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Change the script every page loads to about 20 kB (gzip) less: the core's message catalogs, the editors' texts of the schema and the preview's listener no longer reach the browser. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Change dates in user-locale zones to follow the region of the browser's first language when it is the same language and the locale names no region (`en` reads 25/10/2026 in an en-GB browser); numbers and words stay in the locale's language. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Change multi-choice values in content files: `none` says there are none, and an empty list on a required field is an error, so deleting the values no longer publishes "none". ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Change the `ginko check` messages for content files: they name the key you typed, a list row by its place (`row 3`), and the format to write (euros, `YYYY-MM-DD`, `HH:MM`, a period, an entry id). A YAML error in Markdown frontmatter now names the file and the line. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Change the message for an entry that exists twice: it names both files, so the owner sees the one they just added. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Change the docs layer to draw icons itself instead of with @nuxt/icon: pages outside the docs no longer download an icon library (about 16 KB gzip less on every page of a site that embeds the docs), and docs pages load only the icons they use. Icon names work as before (any installed Iconify set). The build finds them in your Markdown front matter and component attributes (not in prose or code blocks), in YAML and JSON content, in `app.config.ts` and in your own `app/` components (`<Icon name="lucide:x" />`); it reads all locales and ignores commented-out code. A name built at runtime (a variable) is not found, so write it once as a literal; a name that is not installed logs one build warning with its file. A site's own `@nuxt/icon` still wins over the layer's `Icon`. Remove the `icon` options from your nuxt.config if you set any. The icon hints in the editor now say "needs a global Icon component". ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Change the phone header and menu of the docs layer: the light/dark button stays in the header, and the menu lists the languages as links at its top, one tap each. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Change the JSON-LD of a blog post from Article to BlogPosting, built by `postJsonLd` of `@lupinum/ginko/basics`, with the post's tags as keywords. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Change lunch and menu allergens to be asked again when the dish changes. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Change "Heute geschlossen" to work for any single day: the field is now labelled "Geschlossen am" with hints, and `upcomingClosures` lists a `closedOn` day after today, so the site announces tomorrow's closure. Each owner closure it returns has `field`, the bundle path of its reason. `closedOnClosure(hours, today)` gives that day alone, for a list without the days limit. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Change `menu()`: "Preis ändern" now shows the planned price and its date, and the task "Preis ab …" (`menu.priceFrom`) is gone. Staff who only had "Preis ab …" need "Preis ändern" granted again; "Gericht hinzufügen" no longer asks for a planned price. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Change the "Betriebsurlaub und Ausnahmen" task to also show how many days ahead the website announces a closure ("Schließungen ankündigen (Tage vorher)", with a hint), so the owner learns when guests first see it. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Change the public holiday setting to explain itself: a hint says it covers every public holiday, that "wie am Sonntag" takes the Sunday hours of that day, and that a single holiday gets other hours as an exception. The option "normal" now reads "normale Zeiten des Wochentags". ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Change the labels of the two opening times of a day from "Mittag/Abend von/bis" to "Öffnet um", "Schließt um", "Öffnet wieder um" and "Schließt wieder um", so winter hours in the first period no longer read as lunch. The stored field names stay. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Change three Studio labels of the gastro preset: the menu category “Desserts” is “Nachspeisen” in German, the hour plans are “Öffnungszeiten ab Datum” (“Opening hours from a date”), and the English holiday task reads “Holiday closures and exceptions” like its field. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))

### Fixed

- Fix the Markdown twin and llms.txt slowing down on a title with a long run of spaces ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix the message for text in square brackets that is no link or image (`![Bild(datei)` or `[sic]`): it now names the missing "]" or address and how to write brackets as text, instead of reporting an unknown component "span". ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix a site refusing its own content as "bundle too large" when its texts are heavily formatted: the size limit now covers everything the platform allows (4 MiB of text plus 8 MiB of Markdown trees). ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix `nuxt dev` ignoring changes to `ginko.config.ts`: a saved change now restarts the dev server, and a save with an error is reported in the terminal while the site keeps running with the last good version. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix a missing entry from useGinkoEntry showing the last entry instead of the 404 when other code, such as useGinkoMarkdown, read it first; it now throws on every read and is a `Readonly<Ref>`. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix llms.txt, the Markdown twin of a page, its 404 suggestions and the site search naming an entry without a `title` field by its id (`people/lena-hofer`): they now use the field its slug is made from, such as a person's `name` with `people({ route })`. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix `$file.<id>` references inside fenced or inline code counting as picture uses: they are text now, for the file checks and for the `local:files-export` rewrite. An escaped backtick (`` \` ``) opens no code. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix `local:files-export`: a content file marked `draft: true` stays out of the export, as it stays out of the build, instead of making the import refuse every entry. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Fix llms.txt, link checks and Markdown block splitting slowing down on a long run of slashes, spaces or tabs, or on many unclosed `::snippet{` ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix upcomingPlans to end a plan's shown range on the last day planOn still gives to that plan. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Fix image descriptions accepting invisible control characters and bidi overrides: an image field's description now refuses them with the same message as a text field. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix `local:import` for big and inconsistent exports: it refuses a collection over its maximum, an entry ID twice or two entries at one address before it clears anything, imports thousands of entries and references in smaller calls, prints no schema warning when there is none, and suggests running it again only when that can finish. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix links to entries in Markdown texts (`[Anna]($authors.<id>)`) after an import: they now point at the entry's new ID instead of showing as broken on the site. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix local imports on a busy machine: Convex's "Function execution timed out" is now read from `convex run` and the import tries again (up to three times, with growing waits). ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix the reason of a failed local command: it now shows the end of its error output, where the error is, instead of the first line. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix HTML comments in Markdown (`<!-- TODO -->`) showing on the site as text: the parsed tree now leaves them out, also a comment around formatting or around whole paragraphs, and the stored text keeps them. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix Markdown reference links and images (`[Text][g]` with `[g]: https://…`): they now become normal links and images instead of an error about a component named "component". ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix the home page getting a second Organization JSON-LD node from `seo.organization` when the page writes its own (`siteJsonLd`). ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix a PDF of the Files library used as a picture (`![x]($file.<pdf id>)`): the text is now refused with a hint to link the PDF instead. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix a docs site whose bricks all live on the platform failing on every page: `#ginko/search` is now defined (empty) without file bricks. ([#24](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/24))
- Fix the Spanish label of `posts()`: "Artículos" instead of "Entradas", which the Studio uses for entries. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix `ginko check` and `ginko release` refusing a release because of an entry the release does not change or one in the trash: only live entries the release writes, and only when they grow, must fit the entry limit (480 KiB, counted without Markdown trees), and the message names the entry. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix every page downloading the Markdown component registry: only a page that shows Markdown loads it now. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Fix the build of a site with two headings in Arabic script on one page: the search index no longer stops with "duplicate ID". ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix the types of server auto-imports in a site that installs `@lupinum/ginko` from npm: `getGinkoItems` was `any` there. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix the order of a collection sorted by a translatable field (`jobs()` by title): each language's list now follows its own titles, not the German ones (templates/_features/jobs). ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix French, Italian, Spanish and Arabic message texts: Arabic counts use all plural forms and Arabic punctuation, French uses narrow no-break spaces and the typographic apostrophe, and a few wordings read more naturally. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix the silent loss of text after a block component without its closing `::` line: it is now refused with the line it starts on (Studio, agent tools, releases, `ginko check` and the build). Close every block component with a `::` line, also one at the very end of a text; for content files, `ginko check` and the build now fail and name the file and line. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix a week saved as a mid-week day (a lunch week from Thursday) being accepted although the site never shows it: the field that holds a week start (`plans.field`, or the date a task presets to `@workWeek` or `@nextWorkWeek`) now needs the first day of a week, also in content files. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix `//blog` on Nuxt 4: a doubled leading slash now answers with a 301 to `/blog` there too, instead of showing the home page. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix error pages: they get no canonical or hreflang and are noindex. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix page addresses in another case: `/Blog` now answers with a 301 to `/blog`, and the canonical link uses that spelling. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix doubled and trailing slashes: `//blog` and `/blog/` now answer with a 301 to `/blog`, so every page has one URL. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix `ginko check` and the build hiding broken entries: a scheduling date that is not a valid `YYYY-MM-DD` date is now reported instead of leaving the entry out, a scheduled entry is checked like a published one, and a translation must have the same number of list rows as the main file ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Fix the build keeping an entry whose required reference names a draft, such as the sessions of a draft event: it is now left out with the draft. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix every page downloading all Markdown components: a page now loads only the components its Markdown uses. On a page without Markdown components this is about 13 KB less script (gzip) and no idle prefetch of component files. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Fix the 404 page's main-language link ignoring the site's i18n strategy, and name the language in the reader's language ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Fix the focus ring of the default theme in light mode: emerald-700 instead of emerald-500, 5.5:1 against the page instead of 2.5:1. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Fix layout shift on first load of a docs page: the standalone layout preloads Inter, so text no longer re-wraps when the font arrives. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Fix the "not translated" note in the language menu: screen readers read it in the page's language. An empty changelog now says where to add releases. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Fix English fallback text on translated docs pages being read in the page language, and add a link to the main-language page on a docs 404 under another language ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Fix tables with three columns on phones narrower than 360 px: the last column keeps its width and the table scrolls, instead of showing a few letters per line. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Fix docs tables, the home feature list and the install box on phones. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Fix route links outside Markdown (nav, footer, banner, start page): they lead to the main-language page when the current language has no such doc, instead of a raw `$docs…` address. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Fix the docs layer adding a second blog, blog feed or changelog at /blog and /changelog to a site that has its own: it now adds them only at the address of your posts and changelog and only when you have no page there. A changelog page needs `changelog: changelogPages({ locales })` in `pages` (or a `route` on the changelog brick); without an address the build warns once and the layer adds no changelog. The layer now decides after all of your pages are known, so a page that the page-paths module moves to `/blog` also counts as yours, and its links to the blog and changelog follow the addresses you configured. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Fix short tables in the docs ending before the edge of their frame: the rows and the header now fill it. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Fix wide tables, long titles and the previous and next links making docs pages scroll or squeeze text on phones ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Fix the example command after the list of templates: it names the starter, the template to begin with. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix `--template`: a restaurant site now opens with the current lunch week, since the lunch `weekOf` date moves with the other sample dates. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix `--template` sites on Nuxt 5: the font preload plugin and the news feed now type-check, because they use `useServerHooks()` and a relative import of `ginko.config.ts`. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix `--locales` with a new main language for content whose translation has no frontmatter (only text): the main file's fields, such as a changelog's version and date, now move to the new main file instead of failing the build. ([#23](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/23))
- Fix `--locales` with another main language: an image keeps its file when only its alt text is translated. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix `--locales` with another main language: a nested content field it cannot read now stops the copy with the file and field named, instead of being swapped whole and failing the site's build later. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix `--locales` with another main language: a translated photo text or list (gallery, lunch days, closures) now keeps its photo, prices and dates in the new main file instead of failing the build. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix the gastro starter's menu page: it leaves out a dish turned off with "onMenu" and marks a dish sold out today, by the preset's `dishOn` rule. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
- Fix --locales with a new main language: fields only the main file has move to the new main file, and the old main page keeps its address. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))

### Removed

- Remove HEIC from the accepted upload types (`UPLOAD_TYPES`): the Files library cannot read HEIC photos. `local:files-export` now names a HEIC photo and says how to save it as JPEG. ([#21](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/21))
